Quick pass for `65124188068fe6c0dccfe15be695fa6c89cdbd06`:

- The PR targets upstream `main` from `seelesturm/Camcraft-NeoTech` and is mergeable.
- The named fixture, neighboring historical migration test, selected quick gate, and strict app Clippy passed.
- The controlled wrong-reference mutation failed at the Tip assertion and was restored.
- The body states the verification limits. Light lane: Not run.
- GitHub reports no checks. This is not a green CI result.

The quick pass is complete. The PR is ready for independent review. No merge is requested.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 65124188068fe6c0dccfe15be695fa6c89cdbd06 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The complete diff meets issue #2633. The fixture removes `break_through_from` before loading the v63 file. It checks Tip, the stated zero allowance, all drill parameters, the saved reference, and a byte-stable current-format round trip. The decision note explains the choice.

Reviewed against current upstream main's AGENTS.md. Production code, posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, and stock simulation do not change. This is not a safety-tier change. No UI files, external fixture directories, or recorded programs change. Goldens moved: none.

Local results

Base: `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c` (`upstream/main`).
Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-4089`.
The trial merge reported `Already up to date.` The PR directly contains this base: HEAD is the reviewed PR SHA, and HEAD^1 is the base. No merge commit was needed.

- Quick gate against `upstream/main`: 1 selected migration test passed; 0 failed.
- Full `sketch_project` suite: 14 passed; 0 failed.
- Neighboring `break_through::v65_preserves_cutting_steps_and_loads_v63_break_through_and_v62_defaults`: 1 passed; 0 failed.
- Light lane: release build passed; all 11 tests passed across five test steps. These were `motion light: lib` (7), `adaptive_troch_island` (1), `adaptive_troch_neck` (1), `adaptive_troch_parallel` (1), and `app light: pocket_pass_start` (1). The gate reported 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff upstream/main...HEAD --check`: passed. The worktree has no tracked changes.

Extra suites run

The full `sketch_project` suite and the neighboring historical migration test ran in addition to the selected quick test. Importer and external-fixture rules do not apply to this diff. Example catalog suites do not apply because no post or toolpath changes.

Mutations: not run. No production safety logic changes. The author's mutation result was read, but is not an independent reviewer result. No code was changed during this review.

The first build attempt stopped during compile-cache setup. The inherited cache directory was outside the writable roots. All completed checks above ran with sccache disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

No full heavy lanes, GUI, or physical-machine checks ran. The review worktree and branch remain for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
